description: This file contains the implementation of the ShoppingCartDao interface, providing methods for retrieving and manipulating ShoppingCart entities from a database using JPA queries. It includes methods to fetch shopping carts by ID, code, customer, with various fetch joins to optimize data retrieval.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartDao interface, providing database access methods for ShoppingCart entities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ShoppingCart by its ID, including related line items, attributes, and merchant store.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by ID with its merchant store fetched eagerly.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by ID and merchant store, ensuring store-specific data.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by code and merchant store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a ShoppingCart entity from the database.
